rationale: Document the existing local configuration contract using key names and presence booleans only. Preserve .env byte-for-byte and produce a safe binding map for NEWAPP services without adding a second database, OSS bucket, or synchronization layer.
validation_focus: Read and record only variable names and configured/missing booleans; never record, hash, quote, compare, or print values.
Do not modify, rename, normalize, overwrite, stage, or copy .env or agent.env.
Classify existing names into database, shared OSS, authentication, AI provider, and application settings; unknown names may be listed by name only.
Generate docs/CONFIGURATION_CONTRACT.md and .ai/generated/NEWAPP-002-env-contract.json plus focused tests that prove reports contain no values or assignment lines.
Binding documentation must state NEWAPP and NEWERP share the same database and OSS and require no data-sync service; mobile clients never connect directly to SQL Server or embed OSS credentials.
risks: A diagnostic may accidentally echo values or raw .env lines; parse names in memory and emit only allowlisted fields.
Do not connect to DB/OSS/auth/AI services and do not mutate any external system.
Do not change protected control-plane files, Git remotes, or NEWERP.
